name: atelier-commerce
description: Composable watch storefront with a typed Express integration API

scripts.build:services: npm run build -w @atelier/contracts && npm run build -w @atelier/mock-services && npm run build -w @atelier/middleware
scripts.build: npm run build:services && npm run build -w @atelier/storefront
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @atelier/contracts && tsc -p apps/mock-services/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/middleware/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/storefront/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.dev: npm run build:services && node scripts/run-stack.mjs dev
